messages:
alice_dev: Heads up — noticed p99 in the latency dashboard jumped after the quota fallback this morning, but the 'processing' slice stayed flat. Feels like retries are being counted in the endpoint bucket, not the retry path. Anyone else seeing this?
ben_platform: yep saw that too. Dashboard shows endpoint p99 up ~400ms but service processing p99 unchanged. My hunch: client retries are getting attributed to the original endpoint before the fallback hop.
carol_sre: do we have logs that show retry path tagging? If retries are proxied, they might keep the original route tag which the rollup uses.
dan_product: product ask — we need a clearer split in the console between retry-induced tail vs actual server processing. Customers keep blaming model infra.
alice_dev: minimal repro: query window 06:10-06:30 UTC. kql that we run: 
```
select route, tag, latency_ms, retry_count from traces where time between 06:10 and 06:30 and route like '%completions%'
```
I can paste a small sample in a sec.
ben_platform: sample logs: 
```
INFO 06:12:03 route=completions-v2 tag=ingress client_id=svc-123 latency_ms=12 retry_count=1
WARN 06:12:03 route=completions-v2 tag=fallback-queue client_id=svc-123 latency_ms=420 retry_count=2
```
Shows two entries for same logical request.
carol_sre: If the rollup aggregation uses route tag from the first event, it will put the 420ms on that route even though it happened on the fallback path. That's a provenance issue.
dan_product: UX idea: show a stacked p99 with a provenance ribbon: origin=(ingress|fallback|backend). Hover explains how samples are assigned.
alice_dev: agree. Also think we need to change the ingestion transform to prefer the latest 'processing_tag' for tail latency attribution when retry_count>0.
ben_platform: that requires careful backfill rules. We can't silently change rollups and surprise SLO owners. Need a migration plan and a flag to toggle new attribution.
carol_sre: Could add an intermediate metric 'p99_by_path' (ingress, retry, backend) and expose that alongside existing endpoint p99. Safer and additive.
dan_product: +1. We can ship console UI first to make the distinction visible, then flip ingestion once customers are comfortable.
alice_dev: PR sketch: modify sampler to emit sample_origin = last_non_null(tag_chain) when retry_count>0. Quick pseudo: 
```
if retry_count > 0:
  sample_origin = tags[-1]  # prefer last path tag
else:
  sample_origin = tags[0]
```
But we should coordinate with metrics team for rollup semantics.
ben_platform: also ensure tdigest rollups include sample weights per origin or we'll lose fidelity after merge.
carol_sre: observability-bot just triggered: "p99-quota-fallback-high" alert at 06:12. Might be useful to link that alert in thread.
observability-bot: ALERT p99-quota-fallback-high — com.prod.completions — p99=420ms — triggered 06:12:03 UTC — runbook: /runbooks/latency-fallbacks
alice_dev: thanks. Action items: 1) ben to prototype exposing p99_by_path in the metrics API (read-only). 2) carol to add alert annotation linking to origin breakdown. 3) dan to scope console UX for ribbon + hover text. 4) alice to draft ingestion toggle and migration notes.
ben_platform: I'll try a metrics API prototype by EOD — will post a small curl example to exercise origin tags.
carol_sre: I'll update the runbook with a check to confirm whether p99 bump is retry-originated.
dan_product: I'll make a tiny mockup for the ribbon and share in #design later.
alice_dev: if anyone wants the raw sample slice I pulled, tell me and I'll dump anonymized rows. For now marking this thread as action-itemed. :white_check_mark:
